summary: Easier navigation on the Journey Board.

updates.title: Floating Journey Board Scrollbar
updates.body: The horizontal scrollbar on the Patient Journey Board now stays in view, so you no longer need to scroll to the bottom to move across the board.

updates.title: Patient Tracking Search and Shipments
updates.body: Find patients by external source ID, and see Latest Shipment Date and Days Until Next Shipment Due directly in the Patient Tracking table.

updates.title: Journey Board Referral Date Filter
updates.body: You can now filter the Patient Journey Board by latest referral date.

updates.title: Inquiry Reassignment Search
updates.body: The owner and assignee dropdown now supports search and shows the full team.

updates.title: Previous SP IDs Tooltip
updates.body: Fixed historical specialty pharmacy names being cut off in the "Previous SP IDs" tooltip.

updates.title: Bulk Inquiry Assignment
updates.body: Fixed bulk inquiry creation so it no longer assigns inquiries to users without inquiry access.

updates.title: Notes Access for PAL Users
updates.body: PAL users can now create and view notes for consented patients only, and cannot create or view notes for non-consented patients.
